guard: a cotal chat session with no --name appears as the OS login with no suffix, so a peer's mention of that login reaches it; a second session under the name is warned with both remedies; a saved name replaces the login
why: The acceptance for a mentionable human: an agent's @name reaches a session opened with no --name, and two holders of one name are warned. The suite runs bin/cotal.ts, which loads @cotal-ai/workspace and @cotal-ai/cli from dist, so the command builds both and each mutation rebuilds in afterRestore.

mutations.name: the resolver appends a host suffix to the OS login
mutations.expectRed: a session opened without --name is on the roster as the OS login, with no suffix
mutations.cell: a session opened without --name is on the roster as the OS login, with no suffix

mutations.name: the resolver ignores the saved name
mutations.find: else if (chosen) found = { name: chosen.value, source: "preference", from: "your saved name" };
mutations.expectRed: a name saved with cotal config set name replaces the OS login
mutations.cell: a name saved with cotal config set name replaces the OS login

mutations.name: cotal chat drops the name-in-use warning

mutations.cell: a second session under the same name is warned at join, naming both ways to change it
